valueNote: The page explains the Ferrero to Lopez coaching change with the actual on-record quotes from both coaches, and it flags where sources conflict (Equelite 2018 vs 2020 at the academy, height figures) instead of picking one. It also adds the Budge age comparison and the Tokyo comeback context, which top results usually lack.
summary: All 20 listed sources were opened. Every factual claim in the body, summary, knownFor, FAQ and person.json facts was checked against its cited source: 0 WRONG, 0 UNSUPPORTED, 0 OUTDATED. Wimbledon 2023 was confirmed on a second fetch. Soft points only: the 'first round' wording is inferred from the 'Vienna opener' headline and the second-round opponents (acceptable), and the RFET title count of 27 is correctly attributed to that profile but may be worth checking against a current tally. No uncited claims. The article stays in status review for the human editor.
